summary: Full backend + frontend (390x844) test of MercadoLocal. Backend: 28/28 pytest pass (auth, change-password incl. admin change+revert to admin123, upload/files, listings CRUD+filters+permissions, admin stats/users/listings/delete user, AI generate/price/chat SSE+history). Frontend: home feed, chips, search, listing detail (seller/price/city/delivery/WhatsApp -> wa.me opens), register, login (bad + good), Anunciar validation + full publish flow WITH real photo upload via web file chooser + AI generate title/description + AI price suggestion/apply, Conta (my listings, delete, Alterar senha: mismatch/wrong current/success, logout, re-login with new password), admin locked screen, admin login -> /admin stats, Anúncios/Usuários tabs, remove listing, remove user (cascades listings), admin logout, Assistente chat streaming + history persistence + new chat. All core flows work. Issues are minor: contrast on admin total-value card, price parsing with dot decimals, no confirmation on destructive deletes, WhatsApp button contrast, stale test_credentials text.

minor.issue: Invalid category silently ignored and returns all listings (acceptable, but could 400/empty).

ui_bugs.issue: parseFloat(f.price.replace(/\./g,'').replace(',','.')) strips ALL dots, so a user typing '800.50' (dot decimal, common on web/numeric keypads) publishes R$ 80.050,00. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/sell.tsx:115

Delete my listing, admin remove listing and admin remove user (cascades all listings) execute immediately on single tap, no confirm dialog. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/account.tsx:88, /app/frontend/app/admin.tsx:45-60,127

issues: 'Valor total anunciado' card: statBig uses colors.onSurface (#1A1C1A) on brandPrimary (#2A4B3C) => ~1.6:1 contrast, value nearly unreadable; statLabel muted #6E7570 on #2A4B3C ~2.3:1. Use onBrandPrimary for both. Reference: /app/frontend/app/admin.tsx:158-160
WhatsApp button white text on #25D366-like green has low contrast (~2:1); consider darker green (#128C7E/#075E54) or dark text.
After streaming completes, last line of the assistant reply sits partially behind the input bar (auto-scroll ends slightly short).

action_items: Fix admin total-value card contrast (statBig/statLabel inside statWide should use onBrandPrimary / a light variant) in admin.tsx
Fix price parsing in sell.tsx:115 to handle '800.50' (only strip dots used as thousand separators, e.g. if a comma exists or dot followed by exactly 3 digits)
Add confirmation dialog (Alert / custom modal on web) before deleting listings and users
Update /app/memory/test_credentials.md first line: it still says admin seeded from ADMIN_PASSWORD; it is now ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH seeded once
critical_code_review_comments: No hardcoded admin password in code; .env holds only ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH (single-quoted, $ safe); seed only when no admin exists - matches user request.
change-password enforces new != current and min 6/max 72 (bcrypt limit) - good.
AI endpoints: ask_json regex+json.loads can raise JSONDecodeError -> 500 if model returns malformed JSON; wrap in try and return 502.
GET /api/files/{path} is public (by design for listing photos); deleted users' uploaded files are not marked is_deleted on admin user removal.
admin_stats loops over all listings in Python for total_value; use aggregation $sum for scale.
list_listings caps at 500 with no pagination.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_mercadolocal.py (removed hardcoded URL default, fixed 2 test bugs, added TestChangePassword)
seed_data_creation: Created TEST users/listings via seed_ui_data.py and pytest; all test_* users (and their listings) removed with cleanup_test_data.py. Admin password verified back to admin123.
